## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at Calle Puerto de Navacerrada, s/n.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Jellyfish have been on the planet for over 500 million years, and they are here to stay! Learn more about marine animals with tickets to Atlantis Aquarium Madrid.
>
> See sharks, piranhas, turtles, rays, penguins, crabs, and even **Nemo** the clownfish and his friends. Plus, kids can take part in a challenge for a chance to win an Atlantis passport!
>
> Your family will also love the virtual reality adventures under the sea and at the South Pole.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.00. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 233 ratings and 89 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
